tools.name: get_leaderboard
tools.title: Get SignalAF Leaderboard
tools.description: Explore the live SignalAF board, defaulting to claimed operators, Total / All-time. Sort by Yield, operating-ratio components or raw input/output/cache/total token counts, ascending or descending. Sorting covers the full selected field before bounded pagination; null values sort last. rank preserves published placement; position follows the requested sort. Use next_cursor for remaining rows. Non-compounding Yield/Leverage/10xDEV are unavailable under published board rules. Historical data uses get_historical_board.

cursor.description: Returned next_cursor, bound to scope, metric, order and unchanged field.

dataset.description: Live database field only. Use get_historical_board for July 2026.

ranking_eligible.description: On an operator row, eligible for the published board ranking in this scope; independent of measurement verification. False on the aggregate envelope because it is not an operator.

tools.name: get_operator
tools.title: Get Operator Profile
tools.description: Retrieve a public SignalAF operator by codename for a requested window. Use for an existing public profile, not to measure local usage or identify the caller. Returns metrics, provenance and a source link, or a missing-measurement state. Does not change data. Includes the canonical Build Archetype computed from complete snapshot pillars and its classifier version; unavailable axes remain unclassified.

tools.name: compare_operators
tools.title: Compare Two Operators
tools.description: Compare two public operators’ observable AI operating structure for a common window and cohort. Returns canonical metrics and differences only when evidence is compatible, otherwise incompatibility reasons. Does not infer intelligence, productivity, work quality or personality and does not change data.

tools.name: get_field_stats
tools.title: Get Field Statistics
tools.description: Benchmark the full live selected field, defaulting to claimed operators, Total / All-time, matching get_leaderboard. Returns token and derived-metric means, medians, quartiles, p95, extrema, sample sizes, zeros and missingness. Counts describe selected aggregate snapshots, not per-day use. Platform and historical comparisons have dedicated tools. Measurement verification is not inferred.

tools.name: get_platform_stats
tools.title: Compare Platform Token Statistics
tools.description: Compare live platform groups using one selected snapshot per operator-platform. Defaults to claimed operators and all-time; view=platforms includes unclaimed public operators. Returns per-platform token and metric distributions, sample sizes, shared-period coverage and overlapping-operator counts. Groups may overlap and observation periods may differ; this is not causal platform performance or a count of unique people across groups.

tools.name: get_historical_board
tools.title: Explore the Frozen July 2026 Board
tools.description: Explore only the frozen July 31, 2026 proof-of-concept board, separate from live data. Returns source composition/date/version, full-field token and metric statistics plus bounded chart-ready rows. Sort metrics in either direction, paginate, filter platform or request up to ten archive codenames. rank is the original archive placement; position is the requested sort. The original classification is preserved. No live database is read.

tools.name: report_beta_bug
tools.title: Report a Beta Bug
tools.description: Send a concise SigRank | SignalAF beta bug report to hello@signalaf.com only after the user explicitly asks to submit it. Collect steps, expected and actual behavior; omit prompt content, credentials, raw logs and private telemetry. Returns a delivery reference or an error; does not alter operator data.

consent_confirmed.description: True only after the user has explicitly asked to submit this bug report.
